text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. It's somehow gotten even stronger.
Kurumi, Ayane! Don't let your guard down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やはり、
先ほどよりも強い……
二人とも！
油断しないでください！

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text: Waugh... This is even scarier than I thought...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぅぅ……
なんだか怖いよぅ……

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
I-it can get as strong as it wants!
I'll still kick its butt!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どんなに強くなっても、
私がやっつけちゃうんだからぁ……！
